business_process: Agency incident notices and client communications
description: Reaching agency contacts by phone and email; reporting suspected incidents to the sheriff (1 hour), the county (24 hours), and the city (promptly); status calls and meeting attendance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract and CJIS clocks: 1 hour to the sheriff's LASO, 24 hours to the county IT security officer; an agency that hears late about an incident on the owner's side can end the contract; email history is kept by the SaaS provider, so 24 hours of lost drafts is tolerable
manual_workaround: Phone calls from the mobile phone using the printed agency contact sheet; email from the phone or any clean browser
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-consultant (single point of failure); printed contact sheet

description: Configuration, report development, and data migration work inside agency systems (county case management SaaS, city 311 system, sheriff's virtual desktop), using scripts and working files on the laptop
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $720 of billable work per working day; county phase 2 load windows are booked weekends with the county and its vendor, and a missed window slips go-live by two weeks; RPO of 8 hours (one working day) is met for the sync folder but not for scripts in the local repository
manual_workaround: Reschedule non-urgent tasks; work in agency systems from a replacement laptop once it is set up and registered with the sheriff; rebuild lost scripts from agency system logs and notes
dependent_third_parties: County, city, and sheriff (their systems and approvals); productivity suite provider; ISP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-consultant (single point of failure; the only person cleared for CJI)

description: Receiving agency extracts through secure file transfer, holding them only while needed, and deleting or returning them with written certification at the end of each phase
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract deadlines are measured in days (county: 30 days after acceptance), but a lost or stolen extract triggers agency breach notices; RPO of 24 hours because agencies can resend extracts
manual_workaround: Ask the agency to resend extracts through its secure file transfer; certify deletion of any copy that cannot be accounted for

description: Milestone and hourly invoices to agencies and primes; accounting; insurance, tax, licenses, and contract records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $15,000 invoiced a month; agencies pay on their own schedules, so a few days' delay costs little; personal savings cover about two months of expenses
manual_workaround: Invoice later from the accounting SaaS on any clean device; keep paper copies of active contracts in the locked file box
